items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Strauss waltzes, we liked those and I played one or two of them.

ctx.x: We always played that. And the -- cause see, when we had been playing it like we do our work, but it's up fast, you know what I mean. And it has this ring to it. Strauss waltzes, we liked those and I played one or two of them. But not many because they wouldn't want us there for that. They wanted us to do what we call swing. They want jazz. Jazz was well on its way then. Because they even had songs about jazz. Jazz wasn't a music. It was a term that they gave to music.
